name: Kaito Watanabe
source: Kaito is Akari’s father and maternal uncle of Aki. Unlike his daughter who is proper and polite, Kaito is lazy and easy going, preferring to play video games, although he tries his best to be a good father to Akari and a role model to Aki.
translation: Kaito is Akari’s father and maternal uncle of Aki. Unlike his daughter who is proper and polite, Kaito is lazy and easy going, preferring to play video games, although he tries his best to be a good father to Akari and a role model to Aki.
